portrait.template: Vertical phone wallpaper, photorealistic landscape photo. {scene} Calm cinematic mood, soft natural light, slightly darker lower third. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

scenes.white-noise: (now Green Noise, file green-noise.webp, 2026-10-13) A quiet emerald forest stream flowing gently over mossy stones beneath tall ferns and beech trees, soft morning mist between the trunks, rich deep green palette.
scenes.white-noise-radio: Bright white cumulus clouds drifting across a clear deep-blue sky, seen from below, airy, luminous and peaceful.
scenes.pink-soft-noise: Bare winter trees in a dense pink-magenta fog at dusk, a wooden footbridge railing fading into the mist, soft dreamy haze.
scenes.orange-noise: (now River Noise in the white skin, 2026-10-15) A wide clear mountain river rushing over smooth pale grey stones, bright white rapids and foam, silky long-exposure water, pale overcast sky, cool silver-white and soft grey palette.
scenes.brown-ideal-ocean-waves: A powerful turquoise ocean wave curling and breaking, white spray, overcast silver sky, deep teal water.
scenes.brown-light-rain-outside: Light rain falling over a lush green forest, seen from a wet wooden deck in the foreground, soft bokeh, fresh green tones.
scenes.brown-rainy-town-birds: Raindrops on a window pane, a blurred grey-green rainy town street behind the glass, soft muted overcast light.
scenes.brown-thunder-rain: Dramatic thunderstorm over an empty mountain valley road, lightning bolts under dark green-grey clouds, wet asphalt reflecting light.
scenes.brown-spring-birds: A small blue songbird perched on a blossoming almond branch with white flowers, soft bright spring sky with fluffy clouds.
scenes.brown-waterfall: A wide horseshoe waterfall at golden hour, silky long-exposure water flowing into a turquoise pool, dramatic sunset clouds.
scenes.infrared-ocean-waves: Weathered wooden groyne posts leading into a stormy grey sea, waves crashing, wet sandy beach, overcast winter light.
scenes.infrared-arctic-winds: Arctic ice landscape under heavy blue-grey storm clouds, wind-blown snow drifting across a frozen plain, towering ice cliffs.
scenes.infrared-noise-core: High aerial photograph of a coastline where deep crimson and scarlet land with fine eroded channels meets pale pink-white shallow water, diagonal shoreline, rich red and magenta tones, natural textures.
scenes.infrared-deep-noise: A towering saturated red-orange sand dune with a razor-sharp curved crest, one side in deep shadow, fine wind ripples, vivid cobalt-blue clear sky, bright midday desert light.

landscape.method: The chosen portrait image attached as a reference ("ingredient") with this prompt
landscape.prompt: Recreate the attached photo as a wide 16:9 landscape version of the exact same scene: same place, subject, colours, light and photographic style. Extend the scene naturally to the left and right, keep the main subject centred. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

export: Flow JPEG previews converted with: cwebp -q 80 -m 6 <in>.jpg -o <sound-id>.webp / <sound-id>-landscape.webp
